info.title: Invitesion API
info.description: Domain API (ADR-A2). Server-to-server only: every operation except liveness requires the internal service signature.

parameters.name: guest
parameters.description: The last segment of the guest's personal link: an opaque token, or the slug of a guest without one (B-011)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1–255 visible ASCII characters; a retry with the same key and request replays the committed answer for 24 hours

200.description: Saved, or replayed (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`)

401.description: Missing or invalid service signature

404.description: No published invitation, or no guest for this link (`rsvp.link_not_found`)

429.description: Too many RSVP writes for this link or address (`rate_limit.exceeded`); nothing was written

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends

409.description: The event disagrees with its order: another rail (`payment.rail_mismatch`), a PAID event without an amount (`payment.amount_unverifiable`) or with another amount or currency (`payment.amount_mismatch`); nothing was kept and the order is unchanged

category.description: Matched exactly after trimming; empty = guests without a category.

ContentWriteRequest.description: One save: the whole config, prepared from `baseVersion`, and the sections the editor sent.

baseVersion.description:
The version the config was prepared from: `max(invitation_versions.version_no)` when Next.js read it, 0 for an
invitation without a version row.

config.description: The whole config to store, as Next.js's content contract prepared it.

touchedSections.description: The top-level sections the save sent: D-040 judges only their references, and the theme is judged only when sent.

DraftCreateRequest.description: One creation: the template, the event type, the slug before any suffix, the whole config and the creation's key.

templateId.description: The template row (`templates.id`, the price anchor of checkout, publishing and settlement), or null.

eventType.description: One of the six core event types; for a template, the one its catalog category maps to.

slugBase.description:
Lower-case letters and digits in hyphen-separated runs, at most 60 characters; the writer adds `-2`, `-3` … when
the slug is taken.

config.description: The whole config to store, as Next.js prepared it.

creationKey.description:
1–255 visible ASCII characters, stored on the row: a creation by the same owner with the same key answers with the
draft it made (`replayed`), through either writer and without expiry.

version.description: The version this creation wrote: always 1.

replayed.description: True when an earlier creation with this owner and key made the draft.

invitedEventIds.description: Invite-only events ticked in the form; only this invitation's current invite-only events are kept.

GuestFields.description: One guest's values as typed in the add form or held by a file's cells; the rules judge them (`roster-rules.json`).

dryRun.description: A preview: every verdict, nothing written.

oneOf.description: Set when the import cannot be written as a whole; nothing was written.

batchId.description: The new guests' batch, for undoing this import; null for a preview or a refusal.

GuestRsvpRequest.description: A guest's RSVP as the form submitted it.

clientIp.description:
The guest's public address as Next.js's trusted proxies reported it (`TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS`). Used only for the
per-address limit: an IPv4 address, or the /64 of an IPv6 address, reduced to a keyed hash and never stored or
logged. Absent or not an IP literal = no per-address limit (the per-link limit still applies).

GuestWishRequest.description: A guest's wish as the form submitted it.

message.description: As typed; trimmed and judged by the rules (1 to 1,000 UTF-16 units after trimming).

clientIp.description:
The guest's public address as Next.js's trusted proxies reported it (`TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS`), for the per-address
limit only: reduced to a keyed hash, never stored or logged. Absent or not an IP literal = no per-address limit.

version.description: Crate version of the running build.

HostRsvpRequest.description: A host sets one guest's answer: for the whole invitation, or for one event (`eventId`).

ImportRowVerdict.description:
One row's verdict, in file order: `ok` with its slug, `invalid` with the first rule it broke, or `duplicate` of a
guest on the list or of a row above it.

kept.description: Guests of the batch with an open, a send, an answer, a check-in, a wish or a WhatsApp log row.

ticked.description: The invite-only events ticked in the guest's row; stored ids the form could not show are kept.

Me.description: The caller as this application knows it.

Paid.description: What a provider says it collected, in our minor units.

token.description: The text of the pass's QR (`IVP1.` and 48 base64url characters); anything else is answered `invalid`.

scannedAt.description:
When the scanner saw it (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fff]Z`). Kept within the last day; an older time is stored a day
before this request, a future, malformed or absent one as this request's time.

name.description: The guest's display name, for `checked-in` and `already` only.

checkedInAt.description: The stored check-in time (milliseconds, UTC), for `checked-in` and `already` only.

Problem.description: An error response. `code` is stable and machine-readable; `title` and `detail` are for people and may change.

eventId.description: The event a `rsvp.event_answer_missing` problem is about.

questionId.description: The question a `rsvp.answer_invalid` problem is about.

reason.description: The rule a `roster.row_invalid` problem broke: `name`, `phone`, `seats` or `category` (B-033).

currentVersion.description: The version a `content.version_conflict` problem found stored (B-035).

issues.description:
The fields a `content.media_refused` or `content.theme_not_entitled` problem refused (B-035): paths and rules,
never values.

ProblemIssue.description: A refused field by path (`couple.bride.photoUrl`) and rule (`protected-outside-child-photo`).

RecordView.description: One open of an invitation page.

guestId.description: The guest of a personal link; absent for an anonymous open.

token.description: The open link's token (`/daftar/<token>`), or null once closed.

clientIp.description:
The registrant's public address as Next.js's trusted proxies reported it, for the per-address limit only:
reduced to a keyed hash, never stored or logged.

RosterFlags.description: Read in Next.js and sent with each write, as the RSVP writer sends its flags.

opaqueLinks.description: `FLAG_OPAQUE_GUEST_LINKS`: a new guest gets a 22-character link token (B-011).

RsvpFlags.description: The switches the guest page was rendered with (`lib/flags.ts`); Next.js sends the values it renders with.

perEvent.description: `RSVP_PER_EVENT`: an answer per event once the host switches it on for two or more events.

inviteOnlyEvents.description: `INVITE_ONLY_EVENTS`: invite-only events are shown and asked only to the guests invited to them.

RsvpSaved.description: The guest's answer after the write.

status.description: `CONFIRMED`, `DECLINED`, `MAYBE`, or `PENDING` after a host clears an answer.

attendingCount.description: People attending: 0 for a decline, null while unknown.

RsvpSubmission.description: What the guest's form submitted, independent of HTML field names (`RsvpSubmission`).

status.description: The single answer as typed: `CONFIRMED`, `DECLINED`, `MAYBE` or anything else (refused).

guestCount.description: The headcount field as typed; absent and empty both mean one person.

answers.description: Every submitted value of each question, by question id.

SettlementRequest.description: A settlement event the rail adapter verified and normalised (`SettlementEvent` in `lib/payment/types.ts`).

rail.description: `qris` or `stripe`: the rail whose adapter verified the event.

eventId.description: The provider's id for this delivery, unique per rail (1 to 200 characters).

reference.description: Our order reference as the provider echoed it (1 to 120 characters).

oneOf.description: What the provider says it collected, in our minor units; a PAID event without it is refused.

raw.description: The verified event as the adapter normalised it, stored with the event row and the payment row.

applied.description: True when this call moved the order (paid, failed or expired).

oneOf.description: What a payment did to the order's invitation.

recorded.description: False when the open fell inside the dedupe window of an earlier one.

WishModerationRequest.description: The host shows, hides or deletes one wish.

hostReply.description: The stored reply, trimmed; null after clearing.

WishReplyRequest.description: The host's reply to one wish; an empty or blank reply clears it.

state.description: `VISIBLE`, or `PENDING` while the guestbook is moderated.

WishState.description: A wish as the guest page and the host see it.
